description: This file defines a Retrofit interface for interacting with backend cart operations in a Kotlin-based frontend. It includes method signatures for fetching the current cart, adding/removing items, updating quantities, applying/removing coupons, and coupon validation, all via REST API calls.

classes.name: CartApi
classes.description: Retrofit interface defining API endpoints for cart-related operations in the backend, scoped to the current user identified via email.

methods.name: getCurrentCart
methods.description: Fetches the current cart for a user identified by email.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the cart; backend may merge or override quantities.

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity for a specific item in the cart.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart based on productId.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: applyCoupon
methods.description: Applies a coupon to the current cart.

methods.name: removeCoupon
methods.description: Removes an applied coupon from the cart.

methods.name: validateCoupon
methods.description: Validates a coupon code with the backend.
